keys.swarm.aura_arcane_orbs_desc: Magic orbs spiral outward from you, hitting what they pass.
keys.swarm.aura_arcane_orbs_ten: Astral Orrery: big orbs orbit you and small ones orbit them.
keys.swarm.aura_fire_halo_desc: A ring of fire follows a second behind you: its edge burns monsters, its middle is safe.
keys.swarm.aura_fire_halo_ten: Solar Crown: the crown of fire flares out in pulses.
